only_changed_factor: Transient accepted-only same-pseudo cross-source-RX MixStyle in the single raw U student forward
source_basis: Original F21 E30 full source V accepted pseudo precision99.84-99.90% with~95% coverage;prior source receiver/style interaction and paired source smoothing diagnostics support a style-augmentation experiment without raising the gate.
parameter_origin: Existing source-research preset p=.5/Beta(.1,.1)/eps1e-6/time_down+t2.pool;not chosen from target scores.

source_screen.rule: All3 fixed seeds: accepted raw pseudo precision>=99%,true-TX agreement of eligible same-pseudo different-RX pairs>=99%,both actual levels applied>0.No gate on styled prediction accuracy.

limitations: Source pair agreement is not U ground-truth accuracy or proof of augmentation identity;pooled T2 length1 reduces moment mixing to feature-mean interpolation.Source classification errors on the mixed features do not invalidate a correct raw pseudo label.No target guarantee.
